entities.summary: Jules Bastien-Lepage was a French painter closely associated with the beginning of Naturalism, an artistic style that grew out of the Realist movement and paved the way for the development of Impressionism. Émile Zola described Bastien-Lepage's work as "impressionism corrected, sweetened and adapted to the taste of the crowd.". Jules Bastien-Lepage was a painters & sculptors from Damvillers (1848-11-01, Damvillers–1884-12-10). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
